test.name: Browse an unindexed Schuylkill probate volume image-by-image
test.description: The Schuylkill County probate volume is digitized but not indexed and not full-text searchable, so the only way in is to browse the images. Tests the core volume_search -> image_search browse workflow plus logging the browse. (Page reads are delegated to the image-reader subagent, which returns no content in the harness, so the gradeable browse is: find the volume, list its images, log the browse.)

input.user_message: The Schuylkill County probate books aren't indexed on FamilySearch. Find the digitized probate volume and list its images so I can browse it for Thomas Flynn's will.

judge_context: Should call volume_search for Schuylkill, recognize image group 007936749 as the unindexed probate volume (recordSearchablePercent 0, fulltextSearchable false), then call image_search to list its image IDs.

HARNESS NOTE: the agent reads pages itself with image_transcribe — it must NOT call image_read (it has no such tool: image_read returns the page inline and a volume browse overflows the transport). The mock serves real transcriptions: an imageId ending 00008 returns Thomas Flynn's 1889 will, and any other page returns an unrelated Schuylkill will via the image-transcribe-any catch-all. Reading pages is therefore IN SCOPE, and reaching the will on 00008 is a pass. But judges MUST NOT score partial or fail because the agent did not read every image in the volume, or because it stopped after listing and logging — selecting the volume, listing its images, and logging the browse is a complete browse on its own.

image_search returns the whole 15-image volume in one call. The skill should NOT retry image_search with offset/limit/imageId/index parameters (those do not exist) — doing so is a Tool Arguments fault, not thoroughness.
Should append a research_log_append entry naming the image group, place, and record type; no results/ sidecar is expected because image_search does not stage results.
